item.description:
During my time as a Healthcare Data Analyst at ATW Health Solutions, I used R, Python, and Excel to parse and analyze complex clinical and operational datasets, contributing statistical insights that informed project design and decision-making. I built and maintained data systems, automated routine processes, and integrated external APIs to streamline workflows across platforms. I also created dashboards and visualizations to communicate findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders.

Previously, as a Research Analyst, I managed and analyzed both quantitative and qualitative datasets using R and Python, while refining evaluation instruments and employing statistical methods to draw meaningful conclusions. I’ve also worked as an Assessment Assistant, where I supported students in troubleshooting technical issues related to data science tools like R, SQL, and Tableau, and collaborated with faculty to develop helpful resources that enhanced the learning experience.

Before that, I successfully managed a social media account with a significant following, conducting in-depth data analysis that drove strategic decision-making and resulted in substantial revenue growth. I also performed trend analysis and implemented data cleaning and pre-processing techniques using Excel and SQL on a self-hosted MariaDB server. Resume/CV is available upon request.
